note: Catalog of lazily-fetched models (ADR-011). Weights are never bundled. Each entry's 'license' and 'commercial' fields drive the Phase 4 export license gate.

models.name: openWakeWord melspectrogram (16 kHz log-Mel front-end)
models.notes: openWakeWord Mel front-end (Apache-2.0); 16 kHz log-Mel. Byte-identical to the hey-buddy re-host. Served from local prebuilts in dev (ADR-011 amendment).

models.name: Google speech_embedding backbone (re-implemented in openWakeWord)
models.notes: Google speech_embedding backbone re-implemented in openWakeWord (Apache-2.0, ~1.4M params). Byte-identical to the hey-buddy re-host. Local prebuilt.

models.name: Hey Buddy wake-word model (hey buddy)
models.notes: Browser-first wake-word model. Commercially clean (CC-BY-4.0). Replaces the CC BY-NC-SA openWakeWord alexa demo model.

models.name: PLiX Few-Shot encoder (base / small)
models.notes: Compact CNN (EfficientNet-v2 'base' / TinyNet-E 'small') trained as a Prototypical Network; outputs a 1280-dim embedding for prototype-distance matching. Replaces WavLM-base-plus as the Few-Shot encoder (WavLM was too heavy for end-side devices). Apache-2.0 (FewshotML/plix). The published weights are PyTorch .pt (Dropbox); export to ONNX via torch.onnx and drop into prebuilts/plixkws/. Local prebuilt.

models.name: Silero VAD (voice activity detection)
models.notes: Gates KWS to reduce compute and false alarms. Local prebuilt (bundled in openWakeWord release). Not loaded in v1 (RNNoise VAD is used, ADR-018).

models.name: microWakeWord demo model (e.g. 'okay_nabu')
models.notes: Used as a browser-demo MCU model until Phase 5 trains a WakeStudio-owned word.
